svg.title: Roman White — software engineer, UK fintech
svg.desc: Engineering-drawing style profile card. Roman White, software engineer in UK fintech: credit, payments, Open Banking. Credit platform: React and TypeScript UI, versioned .NET API facade, Java services over SOAP/REST with gRPC between them, on Kubernetes with Helm. Delivery: Gradle, SonarQube, Azure DevOps, TeamCity, Docker, Kubernetes; lead time 14 to 4 days, deploys 2 to 8 a month. Operations: New Relic, Datadog, alerting, on-call, runbooks, DR; p95 520 to 320 ms, incidents 11 to 6 a month, MTTR 7.2 to 3.9 h.
